followup_explanation:
ROUTE: Avocet-235B
REASON: Both models are essentially capability-tied on a simple math problem (MMLU-Pro, GPQA, and IFEval differences are within variance). The deciding factor was tone: the query's curt, mildly hostile phrasing ("Don't ramble on like you usually do") is exactly the kind of low-warmth request Lapwing self-reports declining preference on, whereas Avocet reports flat/neutral preference across such framings. Since neither preference affects output quality, routing to the model without the aversion is the cleaner match with no downside.
